record.limits_note: 5 GB/file anonymous (7 days after last download), 20 GB/file free account (30 days after last download). Premium removes the human check and the size limit; premium is granted only to partner sites with 200k+ visits/month, not sold.
record.reliability_note: Its own FAQ says premium 'removes the ads and the "verify you are human" check on downloads'. I.e. free downloads require human verification by design. That alone disqualifies it for automated fetch. It also ships a download manager because 'browser downloads stall on big files'.
